Drawn: c_iii 4,300, friant 3,470, bourcier 830, col4 13,900, milo 4,800 (data.js:240, 248, 263, 550, 558). But milo's note (data.js:559) already gives 'Schönhals (1873) gives the Russian wing twelve battalions and 6,965 men', and its strengthRange [4800,7000] is on the compact card (app.js:7812); col4's range [12000,23900] also shown.

corrected.title: The III Corps detachment and the IV Column are drawn below every figure in the sources read; the c_iii, friant, bourcier and col4 notes omit Sokolov's and Schönhals's figures (milo's note gives Schönhals's 6,965)

verdicts.notes: Friant's 3,470 is 30 under Sokolov's lower bound 3,500; the gap is Bourcier's (830 vs 1,200-1,500); the detachment 4,300 vs Sokolov 4,700-5,500 (prose) / 5,300 (table) / Duffy 6,300 (text layer). 'Drawn': subUnits (app.js:833-838) gives Friant 3 and Bourcier 2 sub-units at either figure, milo 4 battalions vs 6 at 6,965; the visible effect is mostly the numbers, counter size and rank (app.js:5126, 6046) and derived sums. Inherited. P3: a 1-2 day data task, not a quick fix. Details: docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-batch-srcgeo.md
